# console

`command::component`, `console::component`, and `game_console::component` integrate engine commands, Windows console I/O, game-output interception, and an in-game console overlay.

## Contents

- [command.cpp](./command.cpp) — `command::component`, `command::params`, command dispatch, bot/clan management, dvar and command inspection, memory dumping, rawfile extraction, Scaleform discovery, and gametype debugging.
- [command.hpp](./command.hpp) — `command::params`, `add_raw`, overloaded `add`, `execute`, argument accessors, and `operator[]`.
- [console.cpp](./console.cpp) — `console::component`, Windows console lifecycle, input editing, output hooks, colored dispatch, history, logging, and version-title generation.
- [console.hpp](./console.hpp) — `console_type`, `match_compare`, `print`, `error`, `debug`, `warn`, `info`, and `GIT_VERSION`.
- [game_console.cpp](./game_console.cpp) — `game_console::component`, overlay rendering, input handling, autocomplete, history, output buffering, hooks, and version prompts.
- [game_console.hpp](./game_console.hpp) — `is_active`, `toggle`, and `append_output`.

## Architecture / Data Flow

`console::component` captures engine and standard output through `printf_hook` and `com_printf_hook`, classifies messages in `com_printf_stub`, and forwards visible text through `dispatch_message` and `game_console::append_output`.

`game_console::component` queues external output through `append_output`, splits and sanitizes lines through `append_console_text`, renders state through `draw_console_overlay`, and submits commands through `game::Cbuf_AddText`.

`command::component` registers callbacks through `command::add`, dispatches engine invocations through `main_handler`, and connects command handlers to `game::`, `fastfiles::`, `gametypes::`, `dvars::`, and filesystem operations.

## Patterns

`command::handlers` stores lowercase command names in `std::unordered_map<std::string, std::function<void(params&)>>`, while `command::add` installs one `main_handler` callback per engine command.

`game_console::gather_auto_complete_matches` ranks exact, dvar-prefix, command-prefix, dvar-contained, and command-contained matches, prioritizing dvars and deduplicating lowercase identifiers.

`console::component`, `command::component`, and `game_console::component` implement `component_interface`, use `REGISTER_COMPONENT`, schedule main-thread work through `scheduler::main`, and clear hooks or state in `pre_destroy`.

## API Surface

`command::params::size`, `get`, `join`, `get_all`, and `operator[]` expose current engine command arguments through `game::cmd_argc`, `game::cmd_argv`, and `nesting_`.

`command::add_raw`, overloaded `command::add`, and `command::execute` expose native callback registration, parameterized callbacks, no-argument callbacks, and queued command execution.

`console::match_compare`, `console::print`, `console::error`, `console::debug`, `console::warn`, and `console::info` expose classified logging and matching.

`game_console::is_active`, `game_console::toggle`, and `game_console::append_output` expose overlay state, visibility toggling, and thread-safe output submission.

## Behavioral Contracts

`command::execute` appends `"\n"` before calling `game::Cbuf_AddText(0, command.data())`.

`command::params::get` returns `""` when `index >= size()`; negative indices are not explicitly rejected.

`parse_integer` uses base `10`, switches to base `16` for `0x`/`0X` or hexadecimal letters `a-fA-F`, and requires complete `std::strtoull` consumption.

`dump_memory` uses `"%08X  "`, `"%02X "`, `"?? "`, `'?'`, printable bytes `32 <= byte < 127`, and `"\r\n"` row endings.

`dump_memory` prints `"dumpMemory <address> [length] [output]: dump readable memory to consolation/memory_dump\n"` and `"dumpMemory accepts IDA addresses like 0x113D1684 or runtime pointers\n"` for missing addresses.

`com_printf_stub` maps `^1` to `con_type_error`, `^3` to `con_type_warning`, and `^5` to `con_type_debug`, stripping each two-byte prefix.

`error_substrings` contains `"Unable to"`, `"Couldn't reset"`, and `"nat type is Strict"`.

`warning_substrings` contains `"Unable to"`, `"Missing asset"`, `"Couldn't find"`, `"Unknown command"`, `"is read only"`, `"is not a valid value"`, `"is write protected"`, `"already defined"`, `"Adding channel:"`, `"Hiding channel:"`, `"will use the shock"`, `"WARNING:"`, and `"nat type is Moderate"`.

`debug_substrings` contains `"GamerProfile_LogInProfile took"`, `"connection status has changed"`, `"signed in to live"`, `"Reading profile"`, `"Loaded zone"`, `"Loading fastfile"`, `"nat type is Open"`, `"LOADING..."`, `"xuid"`, and `"execing"`.

`game_console::strip_colors` removes `^` followed by an ASCII digit and `'\r'`; `sanitize_display_text` retains only bytes in ASCII range `32..126`.

`game_console::max_console_lines` is `128u`, `game_console::max_history_entries` is `32u`, `game_console::max_input_chars` is `240u`, `game_console::max_auto_complete_matches` is `24u`, and caret blinking uses `500ms`.

## Reproduction-Critical Constants

`command.cpp` uses `CLIENT_STRIDE = 688916`, `CLIENT_REAL_PLAYER_OFFSET = 0x20`, `CLIENT_USERINFO_OFFSET = 1604`, `CLIENT_USERINFO_SIZE = 1024`, and `ACTIVE_PROFILE_INDEX = 0`.

`command.cpp` uses `BOT_NAMES_FILE = "consolation/bots.txt"` and `GAMETYPES_RAWFILE = "maps/mp/gametypes/_gametypes.txt"`.

`command.cpp` resolves `LIVE_CLAN_TARGET_PRIMARY = 0x111CF170`, `LIVE_CLAN_TARGET_SECONDARY = 0x111F1C00`, and `CLAN_DIRTY_FLAGS = 0x1149E6BC`.

## Configuration and Runtime State

`console::build_display_version` combines `VERSION_PRODUCT`, `VERSION_BUILD`, the first seven characters of `GIT_HASH`, `DEBUG`, and `GIT_DIRTY`.

`game_console::build_prompt_version`, `build_full_version_string`, and `build_console_prompt` derive visible version strings from `VERSION_PRODUCT`, `VERSION_BUILD`, `GIT_HASH`, `GIT_DIRTY`, `__DATE__`, and `__TIME__`.

`console::get_log_paths` checks `current_path() / "consolation" / "console.log"`, `%LOCALAPPDATA%/Project-Consolation/console.log`, and `%TEMP%/Project-Consolation-console.log` in order.

`command::bot_names`, `command::next_bot_number`, `console::log_initialized`, `console::log_path`, `console::skip_dispatch_log`, and `game_console::overlay_active` are process-global or thread-local mutable state.

## Safety and Platform Contracts

`command::is_readable_memory` accepts committed `PAGE_READONLY`, `PAGE_READWRITE`, `PAGE_WRITECOPY`, `PAGE_EXECUTE_READ`, `PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE`, and `PAGE_EXECUTE_WRITECOPY` regions.

`command::dump_memory` clamps length to `[1, 0x4000]`, defaults to `0x100`, validates only the first byte with `is_readable_memory`, and reads later bytes through `safe_read_byte`.

`command::write_file_noexcept` caps writes at `MAXDWORD`, requires exact `WriteFile` byte counts, and uses `CREATE_ALWAYS`, allowing existing files to be overwritten.

`game_console::try_copy_c_string`, `safe_read_cmd_name`, `safe_read_dvar_name`, `safe_read_dvar_description`, `safe_read_dvar_hash_entry`, and `try_copy_dvar_domain` use bounded reads with `__try/__except`.

`console::component` relies on Windows/x86 APIs including `AllocConsole`, `GetMessageA`, `MsgWaitForMultipleObjects`, `CancelSynchronousIo`, `VirtualQuery`, clipboard APIs, and structured exception handling.
